user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: Search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads; not used to train foundation models.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content that may be used in training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Content used for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Visit web pages when triggered by user questions or GPT Actions.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs; not for automatic crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Enhances utility and safety by collecting web content for model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content used for AI model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content directed by user questions in Claude.
user_agents.scope: Websites retrieved during user-initiated requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes web content to improve search result quality and relevance.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed for search optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build search indexes, perform product specific crawls, and for analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images, logos, and favicons for Google products.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search image features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Image.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video-related content.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Video.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-News.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Perform testing via Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Google-InspectionTool.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for product teams fetching publicly accessible content.
user_agents.scope: Internal research and development and various product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized fetching of publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Generic image fetching for internal R&D and various product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther-Image.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized fetching of publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Generic video fetching for internal R&D and various product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther-Video.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Execute crawls requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents crawl requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Google-CloudVertexBot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Manage training and grounding permissions for Gemini models.
user_agents.scope: Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API for Gemini, and Grounding with Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index internet information for search experience.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index internet information in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Apple products and collects content for AI context.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling and rendering for search indexing and AI answer generation.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Determines usage of crawled web data for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Secondary user agent that does not crawl webpages directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Apple Podcasts registered content URLs only; does not follow robots.txt.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not support robots.txt opt out.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content of an app or website shared on Meta apps.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays app or website metadata like title, description, and thumbnail.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Train foundation AI models or improve products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for AI model training and direct content indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch individual links at user request and improve agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Fetches links requested by users and helps AI navigate websites to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are user-requested.

user_agents.name: bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages for Bing search indexing and Microsoft Copilot grounding.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for indexing and search retrieval.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow crawling via robots.txt for bingbot.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates page snapshots and previews for Bing and related services.
user_agents.scope: Web pages requested for interactive previews.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow crawling via robots.txt for BingPreview.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve Amazon products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to improve products, provide accurate info, and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt or use noarchive, noindex, or none meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences across Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Specify disallow rules in robots.txt or use page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetch live web information to support user actions and queries.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated fetching for accurate answers; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide open datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Samples and archives a subset of the web for bulk download and research.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to opt-out registry.
